submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.429%) at In0.80Sb0.20. XRD shows it is a mixture of an In2O3 (bixbyite)-type phase and an Sb-rich phase (peaks at Q≈2.79, 4.55, 5.33 Å⁻¹). Moving toward the In-rich end (idx 2: 0.115%) or the Sb-rich end (idx 20: 0.031%) both lowered EQE, so the best region is likely the In-rich two-phase region near In11Sb3O24.
